company.name: Exarta
company.shortDescription: Web3, AI & immersive tech powering the next layer of the internet across commerce, connection, and community.
company.description:
Exarta is redefining digital engagement by merging immersive 3D environments, AI-driven assistance, and social interactivity into a unified ecosystem. Our core products include Odyssey3D, a platform for creating interactive virtual storefronts; Zeniva, an AI-powered shopping assistant that offers real-time product recommendations and customer guidance; Pods.Social, a gamified, customizable social platform where users create and personalize virtual spaces; and The Digital Bazaar, a marketplace for 3D assets and tools that power next-gen digital experiences.
 
Together, these solutions empower brands to elevate customer experience, drive retention, and tap into the growing demand for experiential commerce. Whether it’s transforming e-commerce websites with lifelike AI avatars, showcasing digital products in 3D, enabling social connection through digital pods, or accessing high-quality assets via our marketplace, Exarta is shaping the future of how businesses and consumers interact online.
 
Led by a global team with experience across AI, web3, and digital commerce, Exarta is positioned at the intersection of innovation and scalability. Our B2B and B2C strategies are designed to unlock value across industries—from retail and fashion to real estate and entertainment.
